articles.summary: December’s release marks a major evolution for Cinapse—introducing production-based workflows, new permissions, new pricing tiers, and the foundation for what’s next, alongside our milestone of joining Wrapbook to build a unified production platform.
articles.title: What's New in Cinapse — December 2025

articles.summary: Cinapse is proud to announce its acquisition by Wrapbook, Hollywood’s fastest-growing payroll and production finance platform. This partnership marks a major leap forward in unifying the workflows that power film and television — bringing scheduling, budgeting, payroll, cost reporting, and accounting into a single, modern ecosystem.
articles.title: Cinapse Is Joining Wrapbook
